title: Outside what I have loaded
explanation: A bounced cheque has its own Act and a short deadline. I have not loaded the Negotiable Instruments Act, so I will not quote a section from it. I only handle three problems: a security deposit that was not returned, a refund that was not paid, and wages that stopped. I would rather say that than invent a section for a problem I have not loaded. A real lawyer should hear a cheque case, a property case, a criminal case, or anything where the deadline may already be close.
options: Take this to a lawyer this week if a cheque, a police case, or a court deadline is involved.
lawyer: This one needs a lawyer. I do not have the statute loaded.
